cases.citation: Zilog UM0080 PUSH writes the high byte first and the low byte second. The guest seeds 0x17FE/0x17FD to AA/BB, observes the pair during a BUSREQ grant, then observes it after release.
The guest's PUSH BC uses BC=0x1234 and stack pointer 0x17FF; after the mid-instruction grant releases, the same stack pair must contain 0x1234 exactly once.
